---
title: "Euro area inflation"
subtitle: "Monthly bulletin of the Northbridge Statistical Office"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(eurostat)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(brand.yml)

hicp <- get_eurostat(
  "prc_hicp_minr",
  filters = list(geo = "EA", unit = "RCH_A", coicop18 = "TOTAL")
)
hicp <- hicp[order(hicp$time), ]
latest <- hicp[nrow(hicp), ]
previous <- hicp[nrow(hicp) - 1, ]
month <- format(latest$time, "%B %Y")
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", x)
```

Annual inflation in the euro area was `r pct(latest$values)` in `r month`,
against `r pct(previous$values)` the month before.

```{r}
#| label: fig-trend
#| fig-cap: "Annual inflation in the euro area, all items, %"
#| fig-alt: "Line chart of the annual HICP inflation rate in the euro area over the last five years."
recent <- hicp[hicp$time >= latest$time - 5 * 365, ]
ggplot(recent, aes(time, values)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_brand_ggplot2()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-countries
#| tbl-cap: "Annual inflation by country, %"
countries <- get_eurostat(
  "prc_hicp_minr",
  filters = list(geo = c("EA", "DE", "FR", "IT", "ES", "NL"),
                 unit = "RCH_A", coicop18 = "TOTAL"),
  time_format = "date"
)
countries <- as.data.frame(countries[countries$time %in% c(previous$time, latest$time), ])
tab <- reshape(countries[, c("geo", "time", "values")],
               idvar = "geo", timevar = "time", direction = "wide")
names(tab) <- c("Country", format(previous$time, "%b %Y"), format(latest$time, "%b %Y"))
labels <- c(EA = "Euro area", DE = "Germany", FR = "France",
            IT = "Italy", ES = "Spain", NL = "Netherlands")
tab$Country <- labels[tab$Country]
tab <- tab[order(-tab[[3]]), ]
gt(tab) |>
  fmt_number(columns = -Country, decimals = 1) |>
  theme_brand_gt()
```

Prices rose fastest in the countries at the top of @tbl-countries;
@fig-trend shows the trend for the euro area as a whole.
